Title: Ok a new round of doubts for a noobie

Messages.Author: Zouse
Messages.Body:
Always appreciate your support. Have a new bunch of doubts coming from last games.

Blood Hunt> In a blood hunt you cannot use modifier or reactions, but can you still play Vamp habilities or Master cards as Power Strucutre to get more votes?

Sascha Vykos ADV allows to draw a card when other player play a master card. I guess you have to discard just after that correct? Card do not indicate that.

Its possible to make combo with Legacy of Caine (Vampire cannot hunt, but can hunt stealing 1 blood for another matusaleh vamp) with Abactor? (Hunt+4)

Thats all for these week. Thanks all

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Zouse wrote:
> Always appreciate your support. Have a new bunch of doubts coming from last games.
>
> Blood Hunt> In a blood hunt you cannot use modifier or reactions, but can you still play Vamp habilities or Master cards as Power Strucutre to get more votes?
>
Yes and no. You can use any ability that works during any referendum. Power Structure, on the other hand, can be used "during the polling step of a political action". Since a Blood hunt referendum is not the referendum of a political action, you cannot use it.

> Zouse wrote:
> Sascha Vykos ADV allows to draw a card when other player play a master card. I guess you have to discard just after that correct? Card do not indicate that.
>
Correct, it is in the rules. If you have more cards in hand than your hand size, you must discard down. And if you have fewer, you must draw back to your hand size.

> Zouse wrote:
> Its possible to make combo with Legacy of Caine (Vampire cannot hunt, but can hunt stealing 1 blood for another matusaleh vamp) with Abactor? (Hunt+4)
>
You cannot use the default hunt action. You can use any other hunt action such as:
- the one provided by Legacy of Caine
- the one provided by Abactor
- the one provided by Week of Nightmare
- the one provided by Kyoko Shinsegawa...

But in any case, you cannot "combine" two different hunt actions together.

You could however equip an Aaron's Feeding Razor ("The bearer gets +1 hunt.") before to increase the amount of blood you steal with the Legacy of Caine.
